name: fjc-civil-trial-36m
description: Will a newly filed federal civil case reach trial within 36 months?
split_description: Fixed chronological cohorts by FILEDATE with a 36-month label-maturity embargo: train 2010-10-01 to 2014-09-30 (FY2011-FY2014); eval 2017-10-01 to 2018-09-30 (FY2018); holdout 2021-10-01 to 2022-09-30 (FY2022). Train outcomes mature by 2017-09-30, eval by 2021-09-30, and holdout by 2025-09-30; unused gap years are discarded. No random shuffling.
